title: Welcome pack and party card: one primary, an X, no explaining lines
why: Critic on 02 (welcome pack) and 07 (party), both 2 of 5: an explaining paragraph and stash hints, rarity coloured names, a bare close button with no X, a 90 percent party card with a tiny column of text, a lime sentence, a tall empty invite box and no main action. The welcome pack loses its intro and hints, gets 72px rows with an icon tile and the count at the right, a lime primary and an X. The party card is a fitted 960 card with a lime host button and a one line invite field. Restyle only.
now: The welcome pack and the party card are cleaner: one lime button, an X in the corner, no explaining lines.
